ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has revised its post-preferential shareholding pattern to a fully diluted basis following NSE observations, which materially increases the promoter stake from 41.41% to 46.33% while diluting public shareholding. This significant shift is driven by the allocation of 1,093,750 warrants, primarily to Milind Padole, raising his individual holding from 27.74% to 33.82% upon full conversion over 18 months. The necessity for a revised disclosure due to regulatory intervention, rather than proactive full reporting, presents a potential transparency concern.
